sources.title: SAMURAI Model Enhances Zero-Shot Visual Tracking, Open-Source and Free ...
sources.snippet: The newly released SAMURAI model, an enhancement of Meta's Segment Anything Model (SAM 2), offers significant improvements in visual tracking capabilities. SAMURAI is designed for zero-shot visual tracking with motion-aware memory, addressing limitations encountered by SAM 2, particularly in scenarios involving fast-moving or self-occluding objects. This open-source AI tool is completely free ...
